definitions.explanation: A division of a university focused on a particular field of study.

examples.japanese: ⟦{経済|けいざい}→経済：01394_keizai⟧{学部|がくぶ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{学|まな}んでいる→学ぶ：01987_manabu⟧。
examples.english: I'm studying in the economics department.

examples.japanese: ⟦{法|ほう}→法：13620_hou⟧{学部|がくぶ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}りたい→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
examples.english: I want to get into the law faculty.

examples.japanese: {文|ぶん}{学部|がくぶ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{卒業|そつぎょう}してから→卒業：01643_sotsugyou⟧⟦{出版社|しゅっぱんしゃ}→出版社：11765_shuppansha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}った→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
examples.english: After graduating from the literature faculty, I joined a publishing company.

notes:
～{学部|がくぶ} is a suffix attached to a field of study to indicate a university faculty or department.

COMMON FACULTIES:
- {文|ぶん}{学部|がくぶ}: faculty of literature
- ⟦{経済|けいざい}→経済：01394_keizai⟧{学部|がくぶ}: faculty of economics
- {工|こう}{学部|がくぶ}: faculty of engineering
- ⟦{法|ほう}→法：13620_hou⟧{学部|がくぶ}: faculty of law
- {医|い}{学部|がくぶ}: faculty of medicine
- {理|り}{学部|がくぶ}: faculty of science
- ⟦{教育|きょういく}→教育：01313_kyouiku⟧{学部|がくぶ}: faculty of education

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ～{学部|がくぶ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧: to enter a faculty
- ～{学部|がくぶ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{卒業|そつぎょう}する→卒業：01643_sotsugyou⟧: to graduate from a faculty
- ～{学部|がくぶ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{学生|がくせい}→学生：00610_gakusei⟧: a student in the ~ faculty

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{学科|がっか}→学科：00053_gakka⟧: department (subdivision within a faculty)
- ⟦{大学院|だいがくいん}→大学院：04783_daigakuin⟧: graduate school
- ⟦{研究科|けんきゅうか}→研究科：25123_kenkyuuka⟧: graduate school division
